verdict.rationale: Riveter is a hosted data-enrichment API and SaaS service, so a public status page with uptime history and incident postmortems is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, uptime history, SLAs or incident postmortems. The docs cover only enrichment, scraping, search, webhooks, SDKs and MCP connectivity, so this applicable capability has no supporting evidence.
